note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). The Teams team and channel ids are not shown on screen (they are only used in prepare).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }

if (-not $env:MGL_TEAM_ID -or -not $env:MGL_CHANNEL_ID) { throw 'Set $env:MGL_TEAM_ID and $env:MGL_CHANNEL_ID (from Get link to channel; URL-decoded) in this shell first (owner; never written in a file).' }
Push-Location src; python -m flowkit envvars --set mgl_AlertTeamId=$env:MGL_TEAM_ID --set mgl_AlertChannelId=$env:MGL_CHANNEL_ID; Pop-Location
manual_prepare: Teams: create the private team MG Lab Finance with channel Finance Risk, member sam.demo; note the team and channel ids.

Build the flow 'Notify high-risk project requests' in solution MGLabDataverse (Dataverse trigger Added or Modified on mgl_riskscore, filter mgl_riskscore ge 70; bound action mgl_AssessProjectRequest; Teams post with the two environment variables); save and turn on; check two connection references exist.
Smoke test with PR-0002 (budget 80,000); reset PR-0004 to budget 42,000.
If the designer flags premium: start the self-service Power Automate Premium trial for labadmin.

Expand the trigger: Change type Added or Modified, Table Project Requests, Scope Organization, Select columns mgl_riskscore, Filter rows mgl_riskscore ge 70
Show 'Perform a bound action' (Project Requests, mgl_AssessProjectRequest, Row ID from the trigger)
Show 'Post message in a chat or channel' (Flow bot, Channel, Team and Channel from the two environment variables)

environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: flowkit-pull-lint
screens.note: The last lint is expected to exit 1 (F011, F020, F040 on the fixture).

screens.name: teams-alert
screens.account: alex.demo (form save in the app), then sam.demo or labadmin (Teams)
steps: As alex.demo: open the Project Requests app, PR-0004, change Budget 42,000 to 75,000 with Business Justification empty, save (small inset)
Switch to Teams signed in as sam.demo or labadmin
Open team MG Lab Finance, channel Finance Risk
Wait for the Flow bot post: 'PR-0004 ... is High risk (NN).' with the Reasons line (expect a delay: async plug-in, then flow trigger)
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu
team name if it reveals the tenant
Teams channel link (contains the tenant id)

screens.name: flowkit-runs
prepare: Push-Location src; python -m flowkit settings --out ../flows/test-settings.json; python -m flowkit settings --check ../flows/test-settings.json; Pop-Location
screens.note: Prepare runs the off-camera settings check for the ALM scene (expect 4 problems until a test environment's values are filled in).

manual_teardown: Turn off and delete the flow and its two connection references (and the connections).
Delete the environment variable definitions and values.
Delete the Teams team MG Lab Finance.
Run episode 5's teardown (apikit remove, delete mgl_riskscore) if nothing else needs it; restore PR-0002 and PR-0004 budgets.
